$comment: Machine-readable Definition of Done for No AI Slop v1. status is one of: verified | partially_implemented | blocked | not_tested. 'automatable' items can be checked by the referenced command/test; others require infrastructure not present in this environment.

items.statement: Material claims are captured as content-addressed, hash-chained, signed evidence.
Any tamper, reorder, deletion, or forgery invalidates the evidence chain (fail-closed).
items.evidence: packages/kernel-evidence/src/log.test.ts; nas evidence verify on a tampered chain exits 1

items.statement: Agents can only act through TC-07: deny-by-default, audience/resource-bound, replay-resistant.
Every material change is graded across 13 anti-slop dimensions; required Fail/Not-tested blocks; no hidden score.
TC-10 issues a signed release decision consuming only authenticated evidence; incomplete/unauthenticated inputs never Pass.
Production releases require a non-self independent review; self-review is blocked.
The gate CLI exits 0 only for pass/warning and 2 for fail/blocked.
items.evidence: packages/cli/src/cli.test.ts; real run: nas gate on incomplete inputs exits 2

items.statement: The control-plane app renders real kernel output (staging Pass, production Blocked) and the evidence chain.
Primary screens have zero serious/critical accessibility violations across desktop/mobile, light/dark.
Every token color pair meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both themes.
The full control lifecycle runs end-to-end (authorize -> evidence -> anti-slop -> release) and blocks under tamper.
A user can import a GitHub repository and the platform indexes it.
items.evidence: Requires GitHub App credentials + workspace runtime; contracts present, integration not built

items.statement: Two projects run concurrently in isolated workspaces without sharing files/ports/secrets.
items.evidence: Requires container-isolated workspace runtime not present in this environment

items.statement: An authorized build deploys to staging, promotes to production, and rolls back.
items.evidence: Requires Railway CLI/credentials; deployment model present, live deploy blocked
Requires provisioned multi-tenant datastore; data model is contract-only
